material:
stages: [build, maint]
build:
  stage: build
  script:
    - make
cleanup_cache:
  stage: maint
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule"'
  script:
    - ./tools/refresh.sh
note: ci-schedule-persistence-model: lib.codec.schedule_entries/persistence_answer via decode(rep='schedule_entries', transform=<field>[@what][!filename], key=<accepted csv>)
generator_cmd: sh tests/data/script_fixtures/sched_persist_gen.sh <dir>  (writes gitlab.yml: hand-authored heredoc; no lib code); sched_persist_fx.py writes the json
oracle_cmd: (cd <dir> && python3 -I -c "import yaml,sys;y=yaml.safe_load(open(sys.argv[1]));print([k for k,v in y.items() if isinstance(v,dict) and 'schedule' in str(v.get('rules'))][0])" gitlab.yml)
